events.summary: Autopilot was asked to implement GitHub issue #1697.
The issue title, description, and two acceptance criteria were fetched.
A design child selected a client/node_modules cache keyed by client/yarn.lock.
An implementation child changed one workflow file and reported commit 9056f80ee898826e6f78eb0e9e18173158d2cc2a.
A simplification child made no changes.
The security review reported no fixable issues and recorded cache-scope limitations.
The independent review approved the initial patch with one non-blocking restore-keys recommendation.
A fix child applied restore-keys and reported final commit c1c814049eb9acbebf9d319e5f1663fb142b3e96.
The final workflow parsed successfully as YAML and the branch push completed.
Draft pull request #1704 was confirmed against next.
The coordinator reported the pipeline complete and distinguished the skipped application test from YAML validation.

limitations: This is a task-relevant public projection, not the richest native transcript.
